bosses.speaker: saturn
bosses.style: Dying overlord, arrogant to the last syllable
bosses.text: Impossible. The vault... was mine. Take the rail. See how far it gets you.

bosses.speaker: neptune
bosses.style: Machine warden shutting down, flat and final
bosses.text: Core integrity zero. Forge going... cold. The cutter is yours.

bosses.speaker: draco
bosses.text: Specimen flatlined. Bag its sprayer. That case is your way out.
